headword: {芸術鑑賞|げいじゅつかんしょう}
reading: げいじゅつかんしょう
gloss: art appreciation; appreciation of the arts

definitions.gloss: art appreciation; appreciation of the arts
definitions.explanation: The act of viewing, enjoying, and understanding works of art, including visual art, music, theater, and other artistic forms.

examples.japanese: {芸術鑑賞|げいじゅつかんしょう}が{趣味|しゅみ}です。
{学校|がっこう}で{芸術鑑賞|げいじゅつかんしょう}の{授業|じゅぎょう}がある。
examples.english: There is an art appreciation class at school.

examples.japanese: {休日|きゅうじつ}は{美術館|びじゅつかん}で{芸術鑑賞|げいじゅつかんしょう}をして{過|す}ごすのが{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like spending my days off appreciating art at museums.

notes:
Composed of {芸術|げいじゅつ} (art, the arts) and {鑑賞|かんしょう} (appreciation, viewing). Used for all forms of art — visual arts, music, theater, film, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芸術鑑賞|げいじゅつかんしょう}の{時間|じかん}: art appreciation time
- {芸術鑑賞|げいじゅつかんしょう}{教室|きょうしつ}: art appreciation class
- {芸術鑑賞|げいじゅつかんしょう}{会|かい}: art appreciation event

RELATED WORDS:
- {音楽鑑賞|おんがくかんしょう}: music appreciation
- {映画鑑賞|えいがかんしょう}: film appreciation / watching movies
- {観賞|かんしょう}: appreciation (for natural beauty, flowers, fish) — note the different kanji from {鑑賞|かんしょう}

WRITING:
{鑑賞|かんしょう} (with {鑑|かん}) is used for art and cultural works, while {観賞|かんしょう} (with {観|かん}) is used for natural beauty like flowers and fish. This is a common source of confusion.
